The Amalgamation is a guardian construct created by the [[Vigilant Brotherhood]] to protect their hidden sanctum, the [[Grand Archive]].

## Description and Nature
The Amalgamation is a massive, hulking flesh-golem built to follow the last orders it was given: guard the Archives and destroy unauthorized intruders. It navigates its environment without sight, relying instead on vibration, sound, and air pressure. It is designed to be immune to most magical effects. The magical darkness that permeates the [[Central Hall]] of the Archive is its natural environment, and it has patrolled this space for over two centuries.

## Capabilities and Weaknesses
The construct possesses significant physical strength and is highly resilient. It is, however, vulnerable to radiant damage, which disrupts the necromantic bindings that animate it. When sufficiently damaged, it can enter a rage state, increasing its speed and destructive power. A specific command phrase, known to the Brotherhood, can force it to pause briefly.

## Current Status
The Amalgamation remains active within the sealed Grand Archive, continuing its eternal vigil.
